title: Observation event payload
description: Increment 2 added three optional fields, a backward-compatible change that keeps the @2 id (every earlier @2 payload still validates): assignment (the tm:assignment subject the observation was made for), delivery_ref (the delivery observed; assignments sharing one are released together) and recorded_at (when the observer saved it, as against the event time of the release). Increment 3 added the optional from_recording (W11), likewise.

evidence_ref.description: Key into the private store; notes never enter the event log

delivery_ref.description: The delivery id or session reference, not a person's name

from_recording.description: Optional, additive within major 2 (increment 3, W11). True when the observer scored the session from a recording. A partner instructor's clearance counts only such observations.
